provenance.changes: Coordinates kept in the source's map units (0–1024, y down). Geometry simplified (Douglas–Peucker); only highways and main roads kept. Descriptions shortened to 160 characters. Records in removed.json skipped. Tiles, pins, screenshots and game art not imported. Map drawn by Nerdy Birdie Gaming.

pins.name: Stock 305
pins.note: A streetwear store in Stockyard with exclusive looks for Jason and Lucia. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

pins.name: Sara's Unisex Salon
pins.note: A salon with signature styles for Jason and Lucia, including facial hair, makeup and nails. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

pins.name: Electric Fang Tattoo
pins.note: A tattoo parlor in Stockyard with over 50 signature tattoos by the artist collective FAILE. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

pins.name: Jason's House
pins.note: Jason's stilt house in Key Lento, lent to him by Brian. Jason and Lucia's first safehouse, in Chapter 1, until it goes up in flames in Home Sweet Home.

pins.name: Bayside Apartments, 201
pins.note: Boobie's apartment in Bayside, near the Jack of Hearts. He lets Jason and Lucia stay in it from Welcome to Vice City (Chapter 3) until Valentina moves them out…

pins.name: Starlet Motel
pins.note: Jason and Lucia's motel room in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County: their safehouse in Chapter 2, until Checking Out moves them to Vice City for good.

pins.name: Hank's Waffles
pins.note: A waffle diner that Jason and Lucia rob in Rockstar's Extended Look gameplay reveal, where the robbery is shown as a flashback.

pins.name: Brian's Boat Works & Marina
pins.note: The boat yard of Brian Heder and his wife Lori in the Leonida Keys. Rockstar describes Brian as a classic drug runner who still moves product through it.

pins.name: Fleeca Field
pins.note: A sports stadium in Rockridge, Vice City, based on LoanDepot Park in Miami.

pins.name: Gellhorn International Raceway
pins.note: A race track near Port Gellhorn. It appears to draw on the real Sebring International Raceway.

pins.name: Lake Leonida
pins.note: The large lake in the middle of Leonida, next to Ambrosia. It is the game's version of Lake Okeechobee.

pins.name: Leonida Penitentiary
pins.note: The prison where Lucia served time before the story begins.

pins.name: Ocean View Hotel
pins.note: The iconic hotel from GTA Vice City returns, on Shore Drive, Ocean Beach.

pins.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
pins.note: A national park on Leonida's northern border, with hunting, fishing and off-road trails. Its canyon appears to be inspired by Providence Canyon in Georgia.

pins.name: Port Vice City
pins.note: The port of Vice City, which Rockstar calls the cruise ship capital of the world. It is based on PortMiami.

pins.name: Sahara Arena
pins.note: An indoor arena on the Downtown Vice City waterfront, home of the Vice City Narcos. It is the game's version of Miami's Kaseya Center.

pins.name: Vice City International Airport
pins.note: The airport of Vice City, modeled after Miami International Airport.

pins.name: Megamundo Building
pins.note: A skyscraper in Downtown Vice City, home of the Megamundo TV network, modeled after Miami's One Biscayne Tower. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia enter it…

pins.name: Leonida Keys
